import sqlite3, textwrap
sql = textwrap.dedent('''
WITH sales_by_country_genre AS (
    SELECT
        i.BillingCountry AS country,
        t.GenreId AS genre_id,
        g.Name AS genre,
        SUM(CAST(ROUND(il.UnitPrice * 100.0, 0) AS INTEGER) * il.Quantity) AS revenue_cents,
        SUM(il.Quantity) AS units
    FROM Invoice AS i
    JOIN InvoiceLine AS il
        ON il.InvoiceId = i.InvoiceId
    JOIN Track AS t
        ON t.TrackId = il.TrackId
    JOIN Genre AS g
        ON g.GenreId = t.GenreId
    WHERE i.InvoiceDate >= '2021-01-01'
      AND i.InvoiceDate < '2022-01-01'
    GROUP BY
        i.BillingCountry,
        t.GenreId,
        g.Name
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT
        country,
        genre_id,
        genre,
        revenue_cents,
        units,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY country
            ORDER BY revenue_cents DESC, genre_id ASC
        ) AS country_rank
    FROM sales_by_country_genre
)
SELECT
    country AS country,
    genre_id AS genre_id,
    genre AS genre,
    revenue_cents AS revenue_cents,
    units AS units,
    country_rank AS country_rank
FROM ranked
WHERE country_rank <= 2
ORDER BY country ASC, country_rank ASC;
''').strip()
con=sqlite3.connect('/inputs/Chinook.sqlite')
cur=con.cursor()
cur.execute(sql)
rows=cur.fetchmany(10)
print('first rows', rows)
print('count', len(rows))
# fetch all count
cur.execute('SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ('+sql+')')
print('total rows', cur.fetchone()[0])
con.close()
print('sql bytes', len(sql.encode()))
